In 2010 Kathryn Bigelow beat her ex-husband's record-breaking blockbuster to win Best Director. 🎬 He says he stood up first.

Practical grit or giant spectacle? 👇

explained no. 12

instagram_caption:
She beat her ex-husband's blockbuster for Best Director. 🎬

March 2010. Kathryn Bigelow's The Hurt Locker, a war film about a bomb disposal team, cost about fifteen million dollars. Avatar, from her former husband James Cameron, had already earned over two billion.

Barbra Streisand opened the envelope: "Well, the time has come." Bigelow became the first woman ever to win Best Director, and her film took Best Picture too, with only around fifteen million dollars at the American box office.

The twist: Cameron was sitting right behind her. He later told the New York Times he was "the first one on my feet applauding."

Practical grit or giant spectacle? 👇
